description: Engine-agnostic renderer bootstrap config. Describes WHICH engine binding to load and its viewport, not any engine-specific settings.

engine.description: Name of the concrete Renderer implementation to load. "none" (Phase W3: no concrete engine binding shipped) is kept for backward compatibility; "phaser" (Phase W8) is world.frontend.renderer.renderer.SceneGraphRenderer, a backend scene-graph compiler for a browser-side Phaser 3 frontend (see that module's docstring) — matches the existing engine vocabulary in world.frontend.asset_loader.compatibility.KNOWN_ENGINES.

initialSceneId.description: district id to load as the first scene, e.g. world-gateway (Reception).
